subject: anh
chapter: Unit 10. Lifelong learning (Học tập suốt đời)
lesson: Unit 10. Lifelong learning (Học tập suốt đời)
requirements: Dùng câu tường thuật để thuật lại mệnh lệnh, yêu cầu, lời đề nghị và lời khuyên.
Hiểu và dùng từ vựng về học tập suốt đời.

vocab.vi: có hiểu biết, nắm thông tin

words.clueEn: lasting for the whole of your life
to gain knowledge or a skill
to make something wider or more general
to ask yourself questions about something
to keep something at the same level

reading.title: A message to school-leavers
paragraphs: Dear students, congratulations on finishing school. Yesterday, your teachers asked me to give you some advice before you leave. First, they told you to keep learning for the rest of your lives. Learning does not stop when you receive your certificate. You may go to university, take a distance learning course or join a night school, but you should always try to acquire new knowledge and broaden your mind.

Second, I advise you to be well-rounded. Learn a martial art, brush up your English or study psychology for fun. Third, the head of our library offered to help anyone who wants to join our learning community, so do not hesitate to contact her. Finally, remember that hardship is part of the journey. With determination, you can overcome any difficulty. I wish you all the best.

theory.label: Cần nhớ
theory.content: Tường thuật mệnh lệnh / yêu cầu: {k tell / ask / order + O + (not) to V}. Đề nghị: {k offer + to V}. Lời khuyên: {k advise + O + to V}.
Unit 10 nói về học tập suốt đời.

theory.title: Mệnh lệnh và yêu cầu
theory.text: Dùng tell / order / ask + tân ngữ + to V; phủ định dùng not to V.
formulas: {c tell / ask / order} + O + {k (not) to V}

examples.en: “Keep learning,” she said. → She {c told} us {k to keep} learning.
examples.vi: Cô ấy bảo chúng tôi tiếp tục học.

examples.en: “Don’t give up,” he said. → He {c told} me {k not to give} up.
examples.vi: Anh ấy bảo tôi đừng bỏ cuộc.

try.q: “Don’t be late,” she said. → She told me ___ late.

theory.title: Yêu cầu lịch sự
theory.text: Can you … ? / Could you … ? / Please … → dùng ask + tân ngữ + to V.

examples.en: “Could you help me with this course?” → She {c asked} me {k to help} her with the course.
examples.vi: Cô ấy nhờ tôi giúp cô ấy khóa học này.

examples.en: “Shall I lend you my notes?” → He {c offered} {k to lend} me his notes.
examples.vi: Anh ấy đề nghị cho tôi mượn vở.

examples.en: “I’ll help you.” → He {c offered} {k to help} me.
examples.vi: Anh ấy đề nghị giúp tôi.

theory.title: Lời khuyên (advice)
theory.text: Dùng advise + tân ngữ + to V hoặc advise + V-ing; “You should …” → He advised me to …; “If I were you, I would …” cũng thuật bằng advise.

examples.en: “You should study every day,” he said. → He {c advised} me {k to study} every day.
examples.vi: Anh ấy khuyên tôi học mỗi ngày.

theory.title: Đổi đại từ và trạng từ
theory.tip: Tóm tắt: tell / ask / order + O + (not) to V; offer + to V; advise + O + to V.

theory.title: Phát âm: ngữ điệu câu hỏi
theory.text: Câu hỏi Yes/No lên giọng cuối câu, câu hỏi Wh- xuống giọng cuối câu.

items.stem: "Please open your books," the teacher said. → The teacher ____ us to open our books.
items.explain: Yêu cầu lịch sự: ask + O + to V.

wrong_explain.1: Say không đi với O + to V.
wrong_explain.2: Offer là đề nghị làm giúp.

items.stem: "Don't be late for class," she said. → She told me ____ late for class.

wrong_explain.2: Không giữ nguyên câu mệnh lệnh.

items.stem: "I'll carry your books for you," he said. → He ____ to carry my books.
items.explain: Lời đề nghị giúp: offer + to V.

items.stem: Từ nào có nghĩa là "học từ xa"?
items.explain: Distance learning: học qua mạng hoặc từ xa.

wrong_explain.1: Night school là lớp buổi tối.
wrong_explain.2: Adult education là giáo dục người lớn.
wrong_explain.3: Learning community là cộng đồng học tập.

items.stem: I need to ____ my French before the trip to Paris.
"You should take an online course," my friend said. → My friend advised me ____ an online course.

wrong_explain.2: Advise + O đi với to V.

items.stem: "Could you send me the link?" she asked. → She asked me ____.
choices: if I send her the link
items.explain: Ask + O + to V; đổi me thành her.

wrong_explain.3: Yêu cầu không thuật bằng if.

choices: The doctor advised him to get more sleep.
The doctor advised him get more sleep.
The doctor advised to him to get more sleep.
The doctor advised him getting more sleep.

wrong_explain.2: Không có giới từ to trước tân ngữ.
wrong_explain.3: Có tân ngữ thì dùng to V.

items.stem: "Shall I explain this exercise again?" the tutor said. → The tutor ____ the exercise again.
items.explain: Shall I ...? là lời đề nghị: offer + to V.

items.stem: Learning new skills helps you stay ____ about the world.
"Turn off your phones during the lesson," the teacher ordered. → The teacher ordered the students ____ their phones during the lesson.
Theo bức thư, ai đã đề nghị giúp học sinh tham gia cộng đồng học tập?
items.explain: The head of our library offered to help anyone who wants to join our learning community.

items.stem: According to the message, what did the teachers tell the students to do?
choices: To keep learning for the rest of their lives.
To imprison themselves in the library.
items.explain: They told you to keep learning for the rest of your lives.

items.stem: Câu nào ĐÚNG theo bức thư?
choices: The writer advises students to be well-rounded.
Learning stops when you receive your certificate.
Hardship is not part of the journey.
items.explain: I advise you to be well-rounded.

wrong_explain.3: Night school là một lựa chọn.

items.stem: Thuật lại: "Don't forget to register for the course tomorrow," Mai said to me.
choices: Mai reminded me not to forget to register for the course the next day.
Mai told me don't forget to register for the course tomorrow.
Mai reminded me to not forget to register for the course the next day.
Mai asked me if I forgot to register for the course tomorrow.
items.explain: Not to V; tomorrow → the next day.

wrong_explain.1: Không giữ nguyên don't; phải đổi tomorrow.

items.stem: Chọn từ phù hợp: "Reading widely helps ____ your knowledge and makes you a more ____ person."
items.explain: Broaden knowledge: mở rộng kiến thức; well-rounded: toàn diện.

items.stem: Tìm lỗi sai: "My teacher advised me (A) joining (B) a learning community so that (C) I could maintain (D) my motivation."
items.explain: Advise + O + to V: advised me to join.

items.stem: Chọn câu có nghĩa gần nhất: "He offered to pay for my course."
choices: He said he would pay for my course.
He asked me to pay for his course.
He told me to pay for my course.
He advised me not to take the course.
items.explain: Offer to V = tự nguyện đề nghị làm.

writing.prompt: Viết 6–8 câu kể lại những lời khuyên, yêu cầu hoặc đề nghị mà thầy cô, cha mẹ đã dành cho em trước khi em rời trường phổ thông. Dùng câu tường thuật với told/asked/advised/offered + to V.
checklist: Câu đầu giới thiệu người đã khuyên em.
Có ít nhất một câu told/asked + O + to V.
Có ít nhất một câu advised + O + to V.
Có một câu offered + to V.
Mỗi câu viết hoa chữ đầu và có dấu chấm cuối câu.
sample: Before I left school, my teachers and parents gave me a lot of advice. My English teacher told me to keep learning every day. She advised me to read English books and brush up my grammar in the summer.
My father asked me not to spend too much time on my phone. My older sister offered to help me prepare for university. I will remember their words because lifelong learning is the key to success.
